verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents managing flags, experiments, and deployments from CI or scripts through its Experiment APIs. It also offers broad REST APIs for headless automation: server-side ingestion, event export, cohort list/export/upload, dashboard data as JSON, and taxonomy CRUD. However, CI use is explicitly documented only for the Experiment surface, and the Wizard CLI is described only as a one-shot instrumentation command, not a non-interactive automation tool. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless CLI mode, CI-specific guidance (auth tokens, pipeline integrations) beyond the Experiment APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools with the Experiment APIs.
Run the Wizard CLI to instrument your codebase and get a first dashboard from one terminal command.
Send data directly from your server to the HTTP V2 endpoint.
Get data that's displayed on the dashboard graphs in JSON format through the Dashboard REST API.
Create, get, update, and delete categories, event types, event properties, and user properties.
